messages:
Aisha Rivera: Quick heads-up on Glimmer onboarding — seeing tail latency spikes on /chat (p95 ~ 1.8s) and token spend is trending ~35% over their plan. Thinking proactive optimizations: 1) route short-context calls to a compact quantized model (int4), 2) enable prefix/KV caching for session flows, and 3) route peak traffic to Dedicated pool for predictable latency. Suggestions?

Tom Chen: :eyes: Can you paste a couple of example traces and the prompt size distribution?

Aisha Rivera: Link to traces + prompts: https://redwood.app/insights/glimmer/onboard/799864 - main issues are lots of short prompts (avg 120 tokens) interspersed with occasional long summarizations.

Maya Patel: For renewal posture, we should present this as a quick savings pilot — run a 24h int4 trial on staging, then show estimated monthly delta in the renewal deck.

Jon Sato: Happy to run the int4 canary. Two asks: confirm preferred fallback model variants, and a safe rollout policy snippet we can hand to eng-runtime.

Aisha Rivera: Proposed rollout config (will use for canary):
```json
{
  "route": "/chat",
  "policy": {
    "sequence_length_cutoff": 256,
    "preferred_models": ["compact-2.7b-int4", "compact-2.7b-int8"],
    "fallback": "standard-7b",
    "dedicated_pool_hours": ["08:00-20:00"],
    "cache": {"prefix_kv": true, "ttl_seconds": 300}
  }
}
```

Jon Sato: I'll set up a 5% traffic canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC. @eng-runtime-bot please schedule the canary job and wire observability hooks (latency, 5xx, token burn).

eng-runtime-bot: Canary job scheduled: job_id=canary-799864-01, start=2026-05-12T09:00:00Z, traffic=5% :gear: (will post completion status)

Tom Chen: :thumbsup: I'll produce a short slide with estimated cost delta and latency improvement (best/worst case) for the renewal team.

Maya Patel: I'll run a 30-minute enablement session with the Glimmer PMs after the canary ends. Will capture feedback and any functional regressions.

Aisha Rivera: Great — I'll update the renewal risk tracker and capture the expected savings. Also tagging this for next Wednesday CS sync to confirm rollout outcome. :white_check_mark:
